versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support recording timing events of application states Description: AUTOSAR shall support the recording and tracing of application state changes. Rationale: Provide a standardized way to trace timing events on application state changes to ensure tool compatibility and compatibility to TIMEX. Dependencies: – Use Case: Add a trace instrumentation to application state changes. Supporting Material: -
